name: comp-223
title: Icon Right Indicator Select
blurb: Select with icons and right-aligned checkmark indicator.
description: A select combining icon options with a right-positioned selection indicator. Icons use remixicon and are aria-hidden.
use_when: You want rich visual options with the indicator on the right side.
avoid_when: When left-aligned indicators or simpler lists suffice.
a11y: Icons are aria-hidden; text labels provide meaning.
